subject.title: [Bug]: Real-time logs of openclaw cron jobs are not displayed in the chat session of the webui

question: Where should live isolated cron progress be shown: the selected Web UI chat, the cron run's own session, Activity/workboard, a notification/follow surface, or nowhere beyond final delivery and cron.runs polling?
rationale: Current code and docs treat cron runs as isolated automation with final delivery/history, while the requested behavior changes user-visible event routing and could weaken session isolation if mirrored into another chat without a clear contract.

options.title: Define a live cron progress surface first
options.body: Pick one product surface and then implement event routing, UI filters, docs, and proof around that single contract.

options.title: Fold into broader notification work
options.body: Treat live cron progress as part of the Control UI notification/action architecture tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/20237.

options.title: Keep final-only cron delivery
options.body: Document that cron runs expose completion through final delivery, run history, and cron.runs polling rather than streaming into chat.

recommendation.title: Define a live cron progress surface first
recommendation.body: Pick one product surface and then implement event routing, UI filters, docs, and proof around that single contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest visible history across isolated cron seams, Cron page UX, and product scoping for adjacent notification work.
